east_catalysts_risks.notes: Very little in-window (4–7 Nov 2026) East-Bengaluru material surfaced. Fetching was limited: hindustantimes.com refused WebFetch and Deccan Herald returned 403, so the HSBC 1.19 lakh sq ft / ₹207 crore lead could not be confirmed from the original or any second outlet. Searches only found a different HSBC deal in Hyderabad (sub-lease of about 2.03 lakh sq ft) and the 1.2 mn sq ft Prestige ORR pre-lease from July 2026 (secondary/blog sources only). Treat the lead as unverified. The ET NOW billionaire-homes lead is lifestyle content with no primary source and was not reported. No in-window reports were found for Blue Line trials, Sarjapur-Hebbal (Phase 3A) approval, Bengaluru Business Corridor, Hoskote STRR opening, Cauvery Stage 6, or Varthur/Bellandur flooding. Search-result snippets on these were undated or older, and some came via Deccan Herald pages I could not open. I did not report them because I could not quote them verbatim. The most recent confirmed items are the Pink Line (south Bengaluru) status and JLL's Q3 leasing, both just before the window. The suburban rail Corridor 4 (Heelalige–Rajanukunte) slipped to a 2029/2030 horizon in Deccan Herald headlines dated about 12 Aug 2026, which I could not open. Search results also suggested the Blue Line's opening had been pushed to mid-2027 (phased) and March 2028 (full), but I could not verify this. These are leads for a follow-up run.

east_launches_prices.notes: No East Bengaluru residential launch, new phase, RERA registration or priced offer dated 4-7 Nov 2026 was found after 12 searches and 9 fetch attempts. Several search results were aggregators or promotional pages. Both leads were off-focus: the HSBC item is an office sub-lease and the ET NOW item is a lifestyle piece. The HT article could not be fetched and neither lead was verified. Claims reported are older background, and the Brigade Granada item comes from a weak promotional source. Unverified pointers for follow-up: Shriram's Sarjapur Road launch (planned late 2026), Abhee City Urban Glenn at Gunjur, and Sobha One World Hoskote (RERA registered May 2026 per secondary sources).

government_watch.notes:
Thin coverage. Deccan Herald and The Hindu blocked WebFetch (403 or not permitted), and WebSearch often returned stale or off-target results. Only the Ballari Road elevated corridor (BDA, construction start and traffic curbs on 6 Nov 2026) was verified with quotable text from The News Minute and Oneindia.

Not verified:
- Deccan Herald (7 Nov) headline "BDA to take up Rs 725 cr Ballari Road elevated corridor project, existing flyovers to be demolished". Only search-snippet paraphrase was available, so no claim was reported. Cost figures conflict across sources: Rs 725 cr, about Rs 420 cr, and Rs 2,215 cr for the overall package. A broker blog (homebazaar, 21 Oct 2026) said the corridor was still at tender stage, which conflicts with the 6 Nov construction-start reports. Treat the Rs 725 cr figure and the flyover demolitions as unverified.
- Urban Acres "Ring Road ₹1,118 crore", GBA robotic silt trials, Vidhana Soudha laser mapping, Bangalore Mirror GBA road-maps piece, and the e-Khata open house at 62 ARO offices on 7 Nov. None were found in searchable, quotable form.
- Karnataka cabinet, K-RERA, BWSSB, guidance value or stamp duty, and metro items. No in-window primary-source items found.

Background not reported as claims because I had no verbatim page text: Pink Line elevated stretch (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere) had a CMRS inspection on 6–8 Oct 2026 and a letter listing 36 observations, with no confirmed opening date in the results. The Embassy Developments Q2 FY27 pre-sales lead (Rs 3,225 cr) is market and corporate news, outside this task's scope.

metro_watch.notes: Window evidence is thin and mostly about the Pink Line. The main development is that PM Modi's inauguration of the 7.5 km Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere elevated section is now reported for 13 November (earlier 15 November). The 13 November date comes from secondary outlets and Tejasvi Surya's post as relayed by them; I found no BMRCL or PMO notice. Reports conflict on CMRS status: Swarajya says clearance came on 28 October, while Construction World (2 Nov) says clearance was still awaited. Deccan Herald (via search snippet only, page returned 403) reports a peak-hour frequency of 8 minutes with 4 trains and public service from 14 November. I did not report that as a claim because I could not quote the page. I found no official fare, Blue Line, Phase 3 tender, Red Line, K-RIDE or ridership news dated inside the window. The Red Line DPR was resubmitted to the Centre in April 2026 per a search summary, and I could not verify that. bmrc.co.in and kride.in were not fetched. The leads supplied were mostly unrelated to metro (the Hebbal and Ballari Road elevated corridor items are road projects and were not pursued).

north_south_west.notes: The search and fetch tools returned thin, mostly stale results for this window. thehindu.com and deccanherald.com pages were blocked or returned 403, so the Bidadi township compensation lead ("22% of landowners in seven villages", 5 Nov, The Hindu) is unverified. A Deccan Herald search snippet mentioned Rs 1,800 crore disbursed, with 816 of 1,280 consenting farmers paid, but I could not open that page to confirm its date, so I did not report it as a claim. A Deccan Herald snippet said mixed-mode operations would begin in phases from 11 November, which I also could not fetch; verify before use. I found no in-window villa, plot or apartment launch for the North, South or West focus areas, and no developer or RERA pages to cite. Prestige Windgates (Thanisandra) and Embassy's Hebbal project appeared only in aggregator or older items, with no in-window confirmation. The Business Standard, Moneycontrol, Bangalore Mirror and Urban Acres leads did not surface by headline search. The other leads (Yelahanka theft, hotel opening, HSR Layout, drains, South corporation shutting 63 commercial establishments) are not relevant to property or were not fetchable. Nothing here sets a verification status.

social_signals.notes: No relevant in-window (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-07) public social or video content on East Bengaluru property was found. Reddit (reddit.com and old.reddit.com) was blocked to WebFetch, so r/bangalore threads could not be read directly. LinkedIn returned 403 and needs a login. YouTube search pages returned no readable results, because they are rendered by JavaScript. WebSearch returned no reachable Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn items from the window. The only social-derived material found was media coverage of Reddit posts, all outside the window: the Business Today piece of 2025-11-22 (a Reddit thread saying buyers' lifestyles change within 1-2 years) and the GeoSquare piece of 2026-04-07 (a ₹1.05 crore Sarjapur Road purchase debate). Both are anecdotal and unverified, and no official source supports them, so I left them out of the claims. The rest of the search results were developer blogs (Sobha, Brigade, Puravankara, NBR), portal listings and SEO content. These are interested-party material, undated or older, and not worth reporting as in-window evidence. No "guaranteed returns" language from a specific in-window social post was found. An empty result is valid here. A retry with a logged-out Reddit mirror or a YouTube API-free feed might surface more.
